<h2 class="section-title" id="iphone_fold">iPhone Fold</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<div class="table-of-contents">
  <h2>Contents</h2>
  <ol>
	<li><a href="#iphone_fold">iPhone Fold</a></li><li><a href="#foldable_iphone_design">Foldable iPhone Design</a><ul><li><a href="#minimal_crease">Minimal Crease</a></li><li><a href="#hinge_design">Hinge Design</a></li><li><a href="#magsafe">MagSafe</a></li><li><a href="#design_mockups">Design Mockups</a></li><li><a href="#component_leaks">Component Leaks</a></li><li><a href="#cases">Cases</a></li><li><a href="#foldable_iphone_colors">Foldable iPhone Colors</a></li><li><a href="#repairability">Repairability</a></li><li><a href="#early_testers">Early Testers</a></li></ul></li><li><a href="#no_face_id">No Face ID</a></li><li><a href="#ios_27_foldable_iphone_hints">iOS 27 Foldable iPhone Hints</a></li><li><a href="#a20_chip">A20 Chip</a><ul><li><a href="#ram">RAM</a></li></ul></li><li><a href="#foldable_iphone_cameras">Foldable iPhone Cameras</a></li><li><a href="#modem">Modem</a><ul><li><a href="#no_sim_slot">No SIM Slot</a></li></ul></li><li><a href="#battery">Battery</a></li><li><a href="#apple_pencil">Apple Pencil</a></li><li><a href="#naming">Naming</a></li><li><a href="#ios_updates">iOS Updates</a></li><li><a href="#pricing">Pricing</a></li><li><a href="#launch_date">Launch Date</a></li><li><a href="#other_apple_foldable_rumors">Other Apple Foldable Rumors</a></li><li><a href="#apples_second_foldable_iphone">Apple's Second Foldable iPhone</a></li><li><a href="#iphone-fold-timeline">iPhone Fold Timeline</a></li>
  </ol>
</div>

<p>Apple has been working on a foldable iPhone for more than a decade, and we've been hearing rumors about foldables for at least that long. It's finally time for an iPhone with a folding mechanism to launch, and we're expecting the first foldable iPhone to come out this year.</p>

<p>The foldable iPhone will be part of the fall 2026 iPhone lineup. It will be introduced alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max at Apple's Wednesday, September 9 event, and it could launch in the same timeframe. Some rumors suggest it will launch alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models, while others indicate it will come slightly later, perhaps in October, due to manufacturing issues. Timing won't be clear until the device launches. We also aren't sure what Apple plans to call the foldable iPhone, but rumors suggest it could be named the iPhone Ultra.</p>

<p>Apple decided on a book-style foldable design that's wider than it is tall, which will make it unique among foldable smartphones. Most foldable smartphones are taller than they are wide, but the foldable iPhone is rumored to have a 4:3 aspect ratio like an iPad. Apple designed the foldable iPhone to have the same feel as an iPad, and when unfolded, it will have an OLED display that's close to the size of an iPad mini.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_1_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-1 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px; align-content: start;" data-google-query-id="CKbBrpCF4pYDFY0jlgkdW5AzMA"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_1/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt;"><iframe id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_1/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0" name="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_1/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0" title="3rd party ad content" width="1" height="1" scrolling="no" marginwidth="0" marginheight="0" frameborder="0" aria-label="Advertisement" tabindex="0" allow="private-state-token-redemption" data-load-complete="true" data-google-container-id="6" style="border: 0px; vertical-align: bottom;"></iframe></div></div>

<p>It will look like a hybrid between an iPhone and an iPad, with iPad-like functionality and some iPad-like interface options when unfolded. <em>Bloomberg</em> reporter <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/03/29/biggest-iphone-overhaul-ever-rumor/">Mark Gurman says</a> it will be the "most significant overhaul in the iPhone's history."</p>

<p>The iPhone will be around 5.5 inches when it's closed, and 7.8 inches when it's open, making it just a bit smaller than the 8.3-inch iPad mini. It's supposedly going to be as thin as 4.5mm, which would make it Apple's thinnest iPhone to date. The current thinnest iPhone is the iPhone Air at 5.6mm thick, so an iPhone that's even thinner would be an impressive feat.</p>

<p>Apple is using a titanium chassis for durability because the foldable will be so thin, and the company spent time making a durable hinge and a display that's close to crease-free. Many foldables on the market have a highly visible crease in the middle, and Apple wanted to minimize the crease as much as possible. Keeping the crease almost invisible is one of the reasons why it took Apple so long to launch a folding iPhone. </p><div id="AdThrive_Content_2_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-2 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px; align-content: start;" data-google-query-id="CPH9ppCF4pYDFeXg5wMdl7oVYA"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_2/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt;"><iframe id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_2/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0" name="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_2/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0" title="3rd party ad content" width="1" height="1" scrolling="no" marginwidth="0" marginheight="0" frameborder="0" aria-label="Advertisement" tabindex="0" allow="private-state-token-redemption" data-load-complete="true" data-google-container-id="4" style="border: 0px; vertical-align: bottom;"></iframe></div></div>

<p>With such a thin chassis, Apple has to compromise in some areas. The iPhone will have two rear cameras instead of three. It will have a Wide lens and an Ultra Wide lens much like the standard iPhone models, but it will not have the Telephoto lens that Apple uses for its Pro devices because there simply isn't room for it. Apple also didn't have space for the TrueDepth camera system, which means we're going back to Touch ID. Rumors suggest the foldable iPhone will have a Touch ID power button similar to the Touch ID power button on Apple's iPads. There will be no Face ID and no facial recognition for unlocking the device.</p>

<p>A foldable iPhone won't be cheap, and rumors suggest that it's going to be priced starting at over $2,000. It will be the most expensive iPhone in the 2026 lineup, and the most expensive iPhone to date.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_3_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-3 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_3/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt;"></div></div>

<h2 class="section-title" id="foldable_iphone_design">Foldable iPhone Design</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Apple tested several fold styles and device sizes, including smartphones with a middle fold that opens horizontally into an iPad-sized device and a clamshell design that folds in half vertically. Apple went with the book-style foldable that will have an outer display and camera that can be used when the iPhone is closed, and a larger, inner display that offers more screen space.</p>

<p><img alt="Foldable iPhone 2023 Feature Homescreen" width="2500" height="1406" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-995585 lazyload" src="https://images.macrumors.com/images-new/1x1.trans.gif" data-src="https://images.macrumors.com/t/SRV9sqL3-0A9a5hsxistriqFhvw=/400x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Homescreen.jpg?lossy" data-srcset="https://images.macrumors.com/t/SRV9sqL3-0A9a5hsxistriqFhvw=/400x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Homescreen.jpg?lossy 400w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/FO6VoWDkRMxKWUm3ZmOm9Xa9sLc=/800x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Homescreen.jpg?lossy 800w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/_5UpT5lcCrXJhdEAunH7mQ8WT6c=/1600x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Homescreen.jpg?lossy 1600w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/l33xgalOrfexcvaGGli6E-htql8=/2500x0/filters:no_upscale()/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Homescreen.jpg?lossy 2500w" data-sizes="auto" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:2500/1406"><noscript><img src="https://images.macrumors.com/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Homescreen.jpg" alt="Foldable iPhone 2023 Feature Homescreen" width="2500" height="1406" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-995585" /></noscript></p><div id="AdThrive_Content_4_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-4 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px; align-content: start;" data-google-query-id="CIe8p5CF4pYDFVm-KQgd8Z8m8A"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_4/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt;"><iframe id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_4/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0" name="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_4/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0" title="3rd party ad content" width="1" height="1" scrolling="no" marginwidth="0" marginheight="0" frameborder="0" aria-label="Advertisement" tabindex="0" allow="private-state-token-redemption" data-load-complete="true" data-google-container-id="5" style="border: 0px; vertical-align: bottom;"></iframe></div></div>

<p>Rumors suggest the foldable iPhone will have a frame made from <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/08/foldable-iphone-titanium-aluminum-frame/">titanium and aluminum</a>. Apple could use titanium for the stress-bearing parts of the frame to ensure that it doesn't bend, and aluminum in other areas for heat dissipation and to keep weight low.</p>

<p>Current rumors suggest that the foldable iPhone <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/03/06/kuo-apple-foldable-iphone-book-style-2000/">will feature a display</a> that's around 5.5 inches when it's folded in half, and a larger 7.8-inch iPad-like display when it's opened up.</p>

<p>The iPhone could be around 4.5mm when it is open, and 9mm to 9.5mm when it is closed. If it is 4.5mm when open, the foldable iPhone will be Apple's thinnest device by far. That title is currently held by the 13-inch iPad Pro, which is 5.1mm thick. Some rumors suggest it will be a <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/07/16/foldable-iphone-thickness-and-price-rumors/">few millimeters thicker</a>, but it is expected to be thinner than current iPhones. </p>

<p>One analyst, Jeff Pu, believes Apple could be working on not one, but <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2024/05/06/first-apple-foldable-coming-in-2025/">two foldable iPhones</a>, in different 7.9-inch and 8.3-inch sizes, but no other rumors have backed up this claim. </p>

<p>According to one leaker, the inner (unfolded) display <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/04/14/iphone-fold-display-resolutions-cameras/">will measure in</a> at 7.76 inches with a 2,713 x 1,920 resolution, while the outer display (folded) will measure in at 5.49 inches with a 2,088 x 1,422 resolution and a 4:3 aspect ratio. Another leaker has suggested it will have a 7.6-inch display size when unfolded.</p>

<h3 id="minimal_crease">Minimal Crease</h3>
<p>The 2026 foldable iPhone reportedly <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/02/25/apple-2026-foldable-phone-has-no-crease/">has no visible crease</a>, a problem that affects most foldable devices on the market. Apple is said to have pursued eliminating the crease "regardless of cost," and the company has developed a "new material property" that makes the crease disappear. The crease has <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/05/05/foldable-iphone-two-key-advantages/">been described as</a> "nearly invisible" when the iPhone is unfolded.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_5_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-5 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_5/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt; display: inline-block;"></div></div>

<p><img alt="samsung z fold 3 half folded" width="2000" height="1125" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-813141 lazyload" src="https://images.macrumors.com/images-new/1x1.trans.gif" data-src="https://images.macrumors.com/t/ZS2KVIIC4sP83Fe4EBCKtObyJ7o=/400x0/article-new/2021/08/samsung-z-fold-3-half-folded.jpg?lossy" data-srcset="https://images.macrumors.com/t/ZS2KVIIC4sP83Fe4EBCKtObyJ7o=/400x0/article-new/2021/08/samsung-z-fold-3-half-folded.jpg?lossy 400w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/4TOmAIkf_iXfUcgECORBjX6HdI8=/800x0/article-new/2021/08/samsung-z-fold-3-half-folded.jpg?lossy 800w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/vk7AFAd4Hl-xIvYXrSob-YKMvPI=/1600x0/article-new/2021/08/samsung-z-fold-3-half-folded.jpg?lossy 1600w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/5iv59gm__7U0IvReZi_HWi-KhWg=/2500x0/filters:no_upscale()/article-new/2021/08/samsung-z-fold-3-half-folded.jpg?lossy 2500w" data-sizes="auto" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:2000/1125"><noscript><img src="https://images.macrumors.com/article-new/2021/08/samsung-z-fold-3-half-folded.jpg" alt="samsung z fold 3 half folded" width="2000" height="1125" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-813141" /></noscript><em></em></p><div id="AdThrive_Content_6_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-6 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_6/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt; width: 728px; height: 0px;"></div></div><div class="center-wrap"><em>Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold</em></div><p></p>

<p>One of the reasons that Apple waited so long to release a foldable iPhone is because it struggled to make a device that did not have a visible crease, but it may be a problem that has now been largely solved given the uptick in rumors.</p>

<p>Apple is planning to use ultra-thin glass for the foldable iPhone, and Chinese manufacturer Lens Technology could be <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/02/12/apple-taps-ultra-thin-glass-suppliersfoldable/">Apple's primary glass supplier</a>. Corning is likely to provide the raw materials to Lens Technology, with Apple choosing the supplier because of its expertise in glass strengthening and minimizing side cracks after cutting.</p>

<p>The foldable iPhone will use a new type of display panel <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/05/08/apple-foldable-iphone-display-new-tech/">created by Samsung</a>, using a custom display process that Apple has the trademark for. The process includes integrating touch sensors directly into the display panel, reducing overall thickness by approximately 19 percent. The engineering advancement brings a lighter build and a more rigid display structure, and the display meets Apple's requirements for thinness, power efficiency, and brightness.</p>

<p>Apple could use a <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/22/three-new-iphone-designs-allegedly-revealed/">structural glass mid-frame</a> to minimize the visible display crease in the fold, while applying a color filter-on-encapsulation layer together with a circular polarizer module to improve color purity and light transmission.</p>

<p>Advances in <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/04/13/adhesive-is-key-to-crease-free-foldable-iphone/">optically clear adhesive</a> (OCA) have been important in Apple's quest to minimize the visible crease. Very subtle shifts in alignment of the display panel components can cause micro-cracks or deformation, leading to a visible crease. OCA formulations stay pliable during gradual bending, and can flow into microscopic irregularities to reduce light scattering and the visibility of the crease. </p>

<p>Leakers suggest the new iPhone <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/02/25/iphone-fold-crease-measured-production/">will have a crease depth</a> that's under 0.15mm, which is shallow and should be less noticeable to the eye and to the touch than a crease that is deeper. The crease angle is under 2.5 degrees. The crease angle describes how sharp the fold line appears when the display is unfolded. A smaller angle suggests a smoother, flatter transition across the fold. </p>

<p>Smartphone makers like Samsung do not publish details on crease measurements, so it is difficult to compare Apple's crease design rumors to existing foldable devices.</p>

<h3 id="hinge_design">Hinge Design</h3>
<p>To minimize the crease in the display, Apple plans to <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/03/21/apple-liquid-metal-foldable-iphone-hinges/">use liquid metal</a> for the iPhone's hinge, which will improve durability. This is one technique that might allow Apple to get rid of the crease that has plagued other foldable smartphones. Apple's hinge <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/05/05/foldable-iphone-two-key-advantages/">will be higher quality</a> than hinges used for other foldable smartphones. </p><div id="AdThrive_Content_7_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-7 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_7/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt;"></div></div>

<p><img alt="Foldable iPhone 2023 Feature Iridescent Search" width="2250" height="1266" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-995557 lazyload" src="https://images.macrumors.com/images-new/1x1.trans.gif" data-src="https://images.macrumors.com/t/-6vTc_umSI-kns_dsRiFDJ-rYrY=/400x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Iridescent-Search.jpg?lossy" data-srcset="https://images.macrumors.com/t/-6vTc_umSI-kns_dsRiFDJ-rYrY=/400x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Iridescent-Search.jpg?lossy 400w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/5Ueb71aSo-RB7pDhRgcBePbvr0k=/800x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Iridescent-Search.jpg?lossy 800w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/snEX3D6SyEPvuV2Lbrmz-r1VPYk=/1600x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Iridescent-Search.jpg?lossy 1600w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/DKj7ncawhHy1nQgG-0z2A-Lbdo4=/2500x0/filters:no_upscale()/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Iridescent-Search.jpg?lossy 2500w" data-sizes="auto" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:2250/1266"><noscript><img src="https://images.macrumors.com/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-Iridescent-Search.jpg" alt="Foldable iPhone 2023 Feature Iridescent Search" width="2250" height="1266" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-995557" /></noscript></p>

<p>Liquid metal, or amorphous metal, has a structure that is more resistant to bending, deformation, and denting than traditional metal. Its properties are derived from the manufacturing method, which involves rapid heating and cooling. Its structure makes it tougher than titanium alloy, and it has a stainless steel look. Apple may also use a combination of titanium and stainless steel for the hinge. </p>

<p>Apple is allegedly <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/05/18/foldable-iphone-production-stalls/">running into issues</a> with the foldable iPhone's hinge, but the problem isn't expected to impact launch timing. The hinge is failing to meet Apple's quality control standards under prolonged, high-frequency opening and closing. </p><div id="AdThrive_Content_8_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-8 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_8/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt;"></div></div>

<h3 id="magsafe">MagSafe</h3>
<p>Though foldable iPhone dummy models didn't include a magnetic ring, the new iPhone is expected to <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/01/foldable-iphone-ultra-magsafe/">support MagSafe charging</a>. </p>

<h3 id="design_mockups">Design Mockups</h3>
<p>A <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/12/29/foldable-iphone-mockup-hands-on/">3D printed mockup version</a> of the foldable iPhone gives us an idea of what the device will look like. The mockup isn't spot on because we don't know Apple's exact specifications yet, but it is in line with multiple rumors that we've heard at ~7.6 to 7.8 inches when open and 5.5 inches when closed.</p>

<p></p><div class="center-wrap"><div class="video-wrapper"><div class="video-container"><div class="ls_video_embed aspect-16-9 lazyload" data-youtube="zLiz-FQfb2s" data-ytparams="modestbranding=1" data-thumb-size="maxresdefault"><button class="play-btn">play</button></div></div></div><em><a href="//www.youtube.com/user/macrumors?sub_confirmation=1">Subscribe to the MacRumors YouTube channel</a> for more videos.</em></div><p></p><div id="AdThrive_Content_9_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-9 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"><div id="google_ads_iframe_/18190176,1003364/AdThrive_Content_9/5cefe139bf12e211182dda30_0__container__" style="border: 0pt; width: 728px; height: 0px;"></div></div>

<p>It's smaller than the iPad mini, but it will have the largest display of an iPhone to date. It's rumored to have a 4:3 aspect ratio, and it will be short and wide, featuring a book-like form factor. </p>

<h3 id="early_testers">Early Testers</h3>
<p>Early Apple testers of the foldable iPhone Ultra have reportedly been <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/08/23/apple-foldable-iphone-early-tester-thoughts/">impressed with the device</a>. It apparently fits well in a pocket when folded, and has a durable hinge mechanism. </p>

<p>Testers like the iPad-like app layouts that use the larger, unfolded display. The device performs well as a camera viewfinder, but some testers miss the telephoto lens. The foldable iPhone is limited to a dual-lens camera with wide and ultrawide lenses. </p>

<p>Some iPhone customers are likely to miss Face ID, which won't be included, but others will appreciate the return of Touch ID. </p>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="no_face_id">No Face ID</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Because the foldable iPhone is so thin, there isn't room for a TrueDepth camera system. It won't use Face ID, and will instead have a Touch ID side button, similar to an iPad. </p>

<p>There could be a front-facing hole-punch camera for both the inner and outer displays for selfies, but unlocking the iPhone biometrically will be done with Touch ID.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="ios_27_foldable_iphone_hints">iOS 27 Foldable iPhone Hints</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Apple seems to be <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/06/08/ios-27-hints-at-foldable-iphone-with-app-resizability-push/">preparing for a foldable iPhone</a> in iOS 27, and there are new references to a foldable in the operating system's frameworks. Apple has also been emphasizing flexible app layouts that would be useful for a foldable device.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_17_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-17 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>Apple told developers to move away from designing apps for specific devices and fixed orientations, and to instead target a "dynamic range of sizes and aspect ratios." iOS 27 adds support for resizable iOS apps in iPhone Mirroring and on the iPad, and apps in iOS 27 will be automatically opted in to resizability. </p>

<p>Developers have been asked to treat every iOS app as something that may need to be used in a variety of form factors.</p>

<p>iOS 27 frameworks include mentions of "foldState" and "angleDegrees," further hinting at a foldable device. There's also a new key that returns the total count of built-in displays on a device, which would only be necessary if a device had more than one display.</p>

<p><a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/07/20/ios-27-dual-battery-iphone/">In iOS 27 beta 4</a>, there are references to an iPhone with two batteries.</p>

<p><img alt="Foldable iPhone 2023 Feature 1" width="2250" height="1266" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-995556 lazyload" src="https://images.macrumors.com/images-new/1x1.trans.gif" data-src="https://images.macrumors.com/t/GYsyezEpaY-eSTZmfNk1JJbrUGo=/400x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-1.jpg?lossy" data-srcset="https://images.macrumors.com/t/GYsyezEpaY-eSTZmfNk1JJbrUGo=/400x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-1.jpg?lossy 400w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/hFQOtFeHaC-fhFHAk-kH6czhXXw=/800x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-1.jpg?lossy 800w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/dQ1ax6hMn029bHpsEH1WWA1STEc=/1600x0/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-1.jpg?lossy 1600w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/tJtPT2GDaCimERXX815F6ZRMJSA=/2500x0/filters:no_upscale()/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-1.jpg?lossy 2500w" data-sizes="auto" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:2250/1266"><noscript><img src="https://images.macrumors.com/article-new/2025/03/Foldable-iPhone-2023-Feature-1.jpg" alt="Foldable iPhone 2023 Feature 1" width="2250" height="1266" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-995556" /></noscript></p><div id="AdThrive_Content_18_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-18 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>All of the wording in the Settings app on current iPhone models references a single battery, so the plural phrasing is curious and could be for the foldable iPhone. The foldable iPhone is expected to have dual batteries, with one on each side.</p>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="a20_chip">A20 Chip</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>The foldable iPhone <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/06/03/iphone-18-pro-a20-chip-with-new-design/">will use</a> Apple's A20 chip, built on TSMC's 2nm process. </p>

<p>The transition to 2nm will allow for more transistors in each chip, which will boost performance. The A20 chips could be up to 15 percent faster and 30 percent more efficient than A19 chips. Apple is also expected to use TSMC's Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WMCM) chip packaging technology. WMCM will see RAM directly integrated on the chip's wafer with the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine. </p>

<p>Incorporating RAM this way could bring faster performance for overall tasks, better thermal management, and improved Apple Intelligence.</p>

<p>Apple will use <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/06/01/foldable-iphone-rumored-to-feature-vapor-chamber/">vapor chamber cooling</a> for the foldable iPhone even though it's a technique that makes manufacturing difficult. Vapor chamber cooling circulates deionized water to move heat away from the chip inside, distributing the heat throughout the iPhone frame. Apple already uses vapor chamber cooling in the iPhone 17 Pro. </p>

<p>The A20 Pro chip could include <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/03/iphone-18-pro-chip-leak-suggests-improvements/">a 7-core GPU</a>, a wider memory interface, and a larger L2 cache for the efficiency cores. </p><div id="AdThrive_Content_19_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-19 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<h3 id="ram">RAM</h3>
<p>The new iPhone is expected to have 12GB RAM like the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="foldable_iphone_cameras">Foldable iPhone Cameras</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>The foldable iPhone could have an under-display camera for the interior of the device, with a single hole-punch camera for the exterior when it's folded up. The under-display camera is not expected to feature Face ID, with Apple instead adopting Touch ID. The camera could have a <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/11/07/iphone-fold-24mp-under-display-camera/">24-megapixel resolution</a>, which would be an industry first. Some Android devices use under-display cameras, but not at that high resolution. It's not yet clear if the under-display camera rumor is accurate, because other information suggests under-display cameras won't be ready in 2026.</p>

<p>The foldable iPhone rear camera setup <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/06/26/foldable-iphone-dual-rear-camera-rumor/">will have</a> a Main lens and an Ultra Wide lens with no Telephoto lens. Rumors suggest that both lenses will be 48 megapixels, which isn't too surprising because current iPhone models have 48-megapixel lenses.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_20_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-20 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>The two selfie cameras on the foldable iPhone could be in <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/08/12/iphone-ultra-selfie-cameras-same-corner/">the same corner of the device</a>, with one facing out and one facing in. Leaked foldable iPhone screen protectors have a selfie camera cutout in the top right corner of the display when the device is closed, while leaked dummy models show the inner camera in the outermost top-left corner. </p>

<p><img alt="dummy iphone ultra open sonny" width="1154" height="930" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-1059402 lazyload" src="https://images.macrumors.com/images-new/1x1.trans.gif" data-src="https://images.macrumors.com/t/SCsRW4H87oWCXEaCv4du80x-0XE=/400x0/article-new/2026/08/dummy-iphone-ultra-open-sonny.jpg?lossy" data-srcset="https://images.macrumors.com/t/SCsRW4H87oWCXEaCv4du80x-0XE=/400x0/article-new/2026/08/dummy-iphone-ultra-open-sonny.jpg?lossy 400w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/7WRgOSJndnU2SvqRJ2dhDTpXVf4=/800x0/article-new/2026/08/dummy-iphone-ultra-open-sonny.jpg?lossy 800w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/8iTOgpkIexAu1YTwI9qJTiY4Rs8=/1600x0/article-new/2026/08/dummy-iphone-ultra-open-sonny.jpg?lossy 1600w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/f-AW8q6qBqqr64Ti_hESv4yUpJc=/2500x0/filters:no_upscale()/article-new/2026/08/dummy-iphone-ultra-open-sonny.jpg?lossy 2500w" data-sizes="auto" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:1154/930"><noscript><img src="https://images.macrumors.com/article-new/2026/08/dummy-iphone-ultra-open-sonny.jpg" alt="dummy iphone ultra open sonny" width="1154" height="930" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-1059402" /></noscript></p><div id="AdThrive_Content_21_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-21 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>The two slightly offset lenses combine the cutouts and camera modules to one region of the iPhone's chassis, which makes sense for a device where space is limited due to its thin design.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="modem">Modem</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>The foldable iPhone is expected to include Apple's second-generation C2 modem, a successor to the C1X modem. The C2 will be on par with Qualcomm's modems, and it will support mmWave 5G, unlike the C1 and C1X. </p>

<p>The C2 modem will support a privacy-focused <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/05/14/iphone-18-pro-modem-benefits/">Limit Precise Location setting</a> that cuts down on the location data that's available to mobile networks. Networks will not be able to determine exact location with the option, so instead of seeing location down to an address, carriers might instead see the neighborhood where a device is located. </p>

<p>Not all carriers have opted in to Limit Precise Location, but the expansion of Apple-designed modems to all iPhones could push networks to add the feature to lure customers. </p>

<p>Apple's C2 modem could add support for 5G satellite connectivity, allowing Apple to use NR-NTN, or New Radio Non-Terrestrial Networks. The NR-NTN standard can relate to direct phone-to-satellite links as well as the use of satellites as backhaul for carrier networks to extend coverage into remote areas.</p>

<p>The addition could allow the foldable iPhone to offer full internet access over satellite, supplementing 5G networks for increased coverage when standard networks are unavailable. Apple is planning to allow third-party apps to access a satellite connection, plus Apple Maps and the Photos app could work over satellite.</p>

<h3 id="no_sim_slot">No SIM Slot</h3>
<p>Apple's foldable iPhone <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/12/05/foldable-iphone-esim-only-bad-for-china/">won't have a SIM slot</a> and will instead use eSIM, much like the iPhone Air. </p><div id="AdThrive_Content_22_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-22 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="battery">Battery</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Apple worked to increase the power efficiency of its first foldable display in an effort to maximize battery life, and rumors suggest that the foldable iPhone will have decent battery life despite a thin size. Apple reduced the display driver integrated circuit (IC) from 28nm to 16nm, which could lead to battery savings. Apple plans to use high-density battery cells for the foldable iPhone.</p>

<p>The foldable iPhone could have a battery in <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/11/18/apple-foldable-biggest-iphone-battery/">the 5,400 to 5,800 mAh range</a>, which would make it the largest battery capacity that Apple has used in an iPhone. The iPhone 17 Pro Max has the current largest battery at 5,088 mAh.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="apple_pencil">Apple Pencil</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Apple <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/08/30/apple-pencil-for-iphone-ultra-was-tested/">tested an Apple Pencil</a> for the foldable iPhone, but it is unlikely that the accessory will see a launch. Apple's test accessory was stubbier than the version made for the iPads, but otherwise similar. </p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="naming">Naming</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>A few rumors have claimed that Apple will <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/04/07/foldable-iphone-fold-iphone-ultra/">call its foldable iPhone</a> the "iPhone Ultra," including <em><a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/04/27/apple-planning-to-launch-two-new-ultra-products/">Macworld</a></em>. The iPhone Ultra reportedly won't have "18" numbering like the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.</p>

<p>During the rumor cycle, sites have taken to calling the new iPhone the iPhone Fold, but it's unlikely Apple will actually use that name. Samsung already has the Galaxy Fold, and that would be too similar for Apple's tastes. Apple already uses the Ultra naming for the Apple Watch and for the version of CarPlay that more deeply integrates with in-car systems.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_23_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-23 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="ios_updates">iOS Updates</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>The foldable iPhone will allegedly have a display with <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/03/28/iphone-foldable-display-ipad-style-aspect-ratio/">a 4:3 aspect ratio</a>, much like the iPad. Since the display will be close to the iPad mini in size, the foldable iPhone is going to be able to run two apps side-by-side for the first time, with a simplified version of multitasking available. </p>

<p><img alt="iOS 27 Mock Quick" width="2500" height="1406" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-1028322 lazyload" src="https://images.macrumors.com/images-new/1x1.trans.gif" data-src="https://images.macrumors.com/t/Jav40hKvhCs-fCAfcg0nmFK7O5s=/400x0/article-new/2025/11/iOS-27-Mock-Quick.jpg?lossy" data-srcset="https://images.macrumors.com/t/Jav40hKvhCs-fCAfcg0nmFK7O5s=/400x0/article-new/2025/11/iOS-27-Mock-Quick.jpg?lossy 400w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/PVOgLwWhGeS39JB8QE-rZ87zu7M=/800x0/article-new/2025/11/iOS-27-Mock-Quick.jpg?lossy 800w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/jRsQNWkQjvrremRHU2E3cnHUdro=/1600x0/article-new/2025/11/iOS-27-Mock-Quick.jpg?lossy 1600w,https://images.macrumors.com/t/Cmj55YNKcGgTstD0hG-wkgMM80g=/2500x0/filters:no_upscale()/article-new/2025/11/iOS-27-Mock-Quick.jpg?lossy 2500w" data-sizes="auto" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:2500/1406"><noscript><img src="https://images.macrumors.com/article-new/2025/11/iOS-27-Mock-Quick.jpg" alt="iOS 27 Mock Quick" width="2500" height="1406" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-1028322" /></noscript></p><div id="AdThrive_Content_24_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-24 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>Apple is updating iOS to accommodate the larger foldable display, and in addition to being able to use two apps at once, apps on the foldable iPhone will also have sidebars on the left, similar to iPadOS. </p>

<p>Though Apple is making some iPad-like updates to iOS for the new iPhone, it's not going to run iPadOS and it won't support iPad apps. Apple does plan to make APIs that will make it easy for developers to transition their apps to a layout appropriate for a foldable device. </p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="pricing">Pricing</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Apple's first foldable iPhone could cost nearly twice as much as the iPhone 17 Pro Max.</p>

<p>Apple analyst Ming-Chi Kuo believes that Apple's foldable iPhone will be priced somewhere <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/03/06/kuo-apple-foldable-iphone-book-style-2000/">between $2,000 and $2,500</a>, and <em>Bloomberg</em>'s Mark Gurman has also suggested a similar price range. UBS analysts believe Apple <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/07/16/foldable-iphone-thickness-and-price-rumors/">will price it between</a> $1,800 and $2,000, and Fubon Research <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/11/24/foldable-iphone-could-cost-2400/">says it will cost $2,400</a>. IDC believes the average selling price <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/06/26/iphone-18-pro-price-increase-estimate/">will be $2,500</a>, with some models priced at up to $3,000.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_25_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-25 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>The iPhone will have <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/03/12/iphone-fold-these-three-storage-capacities/">three storage options</a>, including 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB. One rumor suggests that approximate pricing could be as follows:</p>

<ul><li><strong>256GB</strong> - ~$2,320</li>
<li><strong>512GB</strong> - ~$2,610</li>
<li><strong>1TB</strong> - ~$2,900</li></ul>

<p>Research firm TrendForce expects the foldable iPhone <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/03/iphone-18-pro-prices-apple-event-next-week/">to cost between</a> $2,099 and $2,299, with the highest tier storage options potentially exceeding $3,000.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="launch_date">Launch Date</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Apple plans to hold its iPhone-centric event on Wednesday, September 9, which is where the new foldable iPhone models will be introduced alongside the iPhone 18 models.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_26_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-26 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>

<p>We've heard back and forth rumors on release timing. Some rumors have suggested Apple's foldable iPhone will be <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/04/07/foldable-iphone-delays-could-push-launch-into-2027/">delayed past September</a> because of late stage production issues, while others suggest it's on time for a September launch.</p>

<p>Apple could introduce the foldable iPhone in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, and then launch pre-orders at a later date. Apple analyst Ming-Chi Kuo believes Apple will use the delayed launch strategy that it used for the iPhone X in 2017, where Apple announced the device in September and launched it in October. Manufacturing challenges have apparently limited early production of the foldable device, so there could be a <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/07/05/foldable-iphone-to-repeat-iphone-x-story/">delayed debut</a>. </p>

<p>Another possibility is a staggered launch based on region. It could <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2026/08/13/iphone-ultra-staggered-country-rollout/">come to the U.S. first</a>, and then expand to other regions.</p>

<p>If the foldable iPhone does launch in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models, it's likely it will be in short supply. Reports agree that the device is complex and there have been manufacturing problems, so it could be hard to get when it first debuts.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="other_apple_foldable_rumors">Other Apple Foldable Rumors</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>Along with a foldable iPhone, rumors suggest that Apple is <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/guide/foldable-ipad/">exploring other foldable devices</a>, including iPads and MacBooks that have foldable OLED displays. Initial rumors suggested that Apple would unveil a foldable iPad or Mac before a foldable iPhone, but now it sounds like the foldable iPhone is coming first.</p><div id="AdThrive_Content_27_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-27 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div>
</div>
</section>

<section>
<h2 class="section-title" id="apples_second_foldable_iphone">Apple's Second Foldable iPhone</h2>
<div class="col-80 center">
<p>After Apple launches its first foldable iPhone in 2026, it will introduce a <a href="https://www.macrumors.com/2025/05/05/apple-second-foldable-iphone-2027-launch/">second-generation model</a> in 2027. The 2027 foldable iPhone will fall on the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's launch.</p>
</div>
